strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged M2SL signal is above its threshold; otherwise cash. (Procyclical orientation: strong money growth = risk-on, consistent with the liquidity channel.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 2 month(s); L1 is the real-time floor given the ~4th-Tuesday H.6 publication lag for the prior month

selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the committed coarse monthly grid L{0,1,2,3,6,12} (3,369 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.7129). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.6882 at L2; the 2nd-best valid combo (accel/T2_roll_p75/P1_long_cash_pro/L2) sits at 1.6517. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.

notes: Mode 3, pair260619_m2sl_yoy_spy. Tournament: 4720 strategy combos (+1 benchmark, valid=False per ECON-T4), 3369 valid. Winner by ECON-T3 cascade (resolved at step 1; 1 tied at step 1). Strategy returns are gross of transaction costs; 5 bps sensitivity in tournament_validation_20260619/. M2 is a revised series (FRED M2SL current vintage; Data Master snapshot is ~0.5% stale). Lead-lag: Toda-Yamamoto Granger M2SL->SPY significant at lags NONE; SPY->M2SL significant at lags [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8]. Robustness caveats: winner bootstrap p = 0.025 (vs resampled B&H); in-sample Sharpe 0.36 vs OOS 1.69; CP1 durability verdict 'conditionally_durable'; rolling-correlation stability 'moderately_stable'. OOS mean position 0.48.
